import sys, tempfile, cozum
from pathlib import Path
sayac = {}
for parca in sys.argv[1:]:
    ad, adet = parca.split("=")
    sayac[ad] = int(adet)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    yol = Path(d) / "sayac.txt"
    yol.write_text("eski\n", encoding="utf-8")
    cozum.sayac_yaz(yol, sayac)
    print(yol.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), end="")
    print("#")
